experiment: Global information into same-size Local; no independent Global decoder input
source_initialization: Completed256minute reference/final.pt at512steps. All groups share these weights; source is now256minute-trained. Old16minute runs are not this experiment.
method: Full256minute encoder+Cross produce G/L; write G into unchanged L[256,2,128,16]; decoder accepts only merged L. Internal Global condition is read from2sides x4spatial-band means of merged L plus fixed relative-time encoding. No original G, raw book, or per-frame anchor is passed to Local-only decoder.
comparison: Same64training windows,16development windows,seed42,full-book batch1 accumulation4 and512end-to-end updates. Three candidates have equal extra warmup; reference has none. Report prewarm,postwarm and all declared endpoints.
precision: BF16 training with activation checkpointing; FP32 evaluation; both TF32 flags off
selection: All declared checkpoints and fixed512step endpoints on the same16development windows; seed42only;2026 is not used for fitting or selection.
warmup: Candidates only:256steps on cached training G/L to reconstruct frozen-teacher G, plus0.01 normalized Local-shift penalty; no development data, no generator updates. Cost is additional and reported separately.
objective_extra: All groups receive0.1 standardized Global-condition distillation to the same frozen256minute teacher during full-book training. Native book loss remains unchanged; candidate native latent_mse penalizes the Local write residual.
scope: Isolate single-Local fusion before further16x1024 compression. Same-size Local is an intermediate bottleneck, not fulfillment of the final16384element state target.
